title: Chugach Explorer Heli Flight-2 Hours-2 Landings-Anchorage Area
includes: Round Trip Transportation Not Included-Can Be Added for Additional Fee
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Weight limit is 300 pounds per seat. R44 max weight is 650 pounds. R66 max weight is 900 pounds.
Service animals are allowed on a case by case basis. Call to inquire.
Accurately reporting weight is essential for proper weight and balance of the helicopter. Large discrepancies in reported weights may result in additional fees.

WEIGHT SURCHARGES: Groups of 2 over 500lbs, groups of 3 over 650lbs and groups of 4 over 900lbs will be charged a weight surcharge. You can call 907-351-6736 to pay the additional weight surcharge within 48 hours of making the reservation. If weight surcharge not paid, we cannot guarantee extra aircraft will be available and flight may be rescheduled or canceled without a refund.
Infants are defined as 0-24 months. Children at or over 24 months will need to be in a paid seat. This is a FAA regulation and not a suggestion
Groups of 4+ may be split into multiple helicopters
policies: CHECK IN TIME is 30 minutes prior to departure time. If you arrive late your excursion may be shortened, cancelled or rescheduled.
Solo Travelers: Please note that we may reach out to reschedule your time if a 2 person minimum is not met.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See the Chugach Range & Knik River Valley from the air as your helicopter pilot takes you on an epic flying adventure. Experience exceptional, unobstructed views of the Alaska wilderness from the air. Fly over stunning mountain peaks, spot wildlife, towering waterfalls, dramatic glacial terrain & beauty that is unique to Alaska before exploring your 2 landing locations!

Experience custom flight paths and landings based on your bucket list items. Step foot on the exposed ice of a glacier in the Knik Valley and trek with your pilot to explore the many facets of the glacial surface (Moulins, blue pools, and deep crevasses), choose a high alpine landing to take in large, sweeping sights of glaciers and rocky ridgelines, land on the shoreline of a massive glacial lake filled with giant floating icebergs, a rocky beach at the face of a dramatic ice wall or let your pilot take you to their favorite landing location!
